text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Today's shoot was a marathon. 
Ended up missing dorm dinner again too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(This has been happening way too much 
lately... Only decent meal I had today was 
lunch. Gotta do something about this, it's 
bad for my health...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Right, bento. If I make a boxed lunch 
and bring it on set, I won't have to miss 
meals... Okay, let's do this.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, seriously?! Burned it again! Don't 
eggs cook way too fast out of nowhere...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Guess jumping straight into making a bento 
was setting the bar too high...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever. Guess I'll just bring this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...I knew it'd be bad, but yuck. This 
part is barely cooked... and there are 
still burnt bits left. What a total 
disaster...)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
City-san, we're ready to resume shooting 
soon!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Whoops. Coming! I'll be right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted Gold City at the park. She 
seemed to be in the middle of a photo 
shoot, but sensing something off in her 
demeanor, I decided to observe.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (...Ugh, my stomach's starting to hurt...)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, City-san! Look over this way 
next, please!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...No, it's not unbearable... at least I 
hope not... Gotta focus on the camera 
right now...)

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
And that's a wrap! Thank you for your hard 
work, City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City? You look pale. Are you feeling 
unwell somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, not really? Might've just gone a 
bit too blue with the makeup.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Is that truly the only reason? You're 
breaking out in a sweat, and you didn't 
seem fully focused either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ............Sigh, you never miss a thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's just a mild stomachache, nothing 
serious. The bento just tasted awful, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
A bento...? Don't tell me you made it 
yourself? Honestly, pushing yourself like 
that...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You could have easily left meals to me. 
You really should rely on me more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, there's always dorm food anyway, it's 
really fine.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
It is not fine... I know a wonderful 
medicinal herb restaurant. Let me take you 
there after this.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I believe they offer takeout, so starting 
next time I can arrange bentos from there—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I said I don't need it! Seriously, you're 
way too overprotective!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(...Geez, why does she always gotta meddle 
like that... Well, I guess I'm the one who 
messed up this time though.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(In the first place, balancing work and 
racing was my own choice. Being busy, meal 
problems—that's all on me.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Gotta get it together... This is a 
problem I have to solve on my own.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I'll drop by a bookstore. Buy a 
cookbook or something and study up first.
